verdict: Ready as a bounded systems/evaluation technical report or preprint after these corrections; not evidence of a new world-model algorithm, beneficial deployed interventions, or validated physical safety.

findings_fixed.finding: The matched-study methods claimed explicit rejection of constant representations, but selection checked prediction finiteness without a retained latent-collapse diagnostic.
findings_fixed.fix: Removed the unsupported rejection claim and stated the diagnostic limitation. Frozen training code and results are unchanged.

findings_fixed.finding: Headline relative gains against old ensembles lacked immediate strongest-control context.
findings_fixed.fix: Added descriptive H5 gains versus OS persistence (55.35%) and physical same-data JEPA (15.42%), including their non-primary status and the physical comparison's failure to meet a 20% effect size.

findings_fixed.finding: Assigned source-label strata are confounded with the generator's pressure regimes.
findings_fixed.fix: Disclosed the modulo-two/modulo-four assignment and excluded source-specific transfer claims. No relabelling or test regeneration.

findings_fixed.finding: Bibliographic attribution and a source locator needed correction.
findings_fixed.fix: Corrected V-JEPA 2 to M. Assran et al., Safety Gymnasium to J. Ji et al. with its official title, and replaced the generic NASA project locator with the paper's NTRS record.

findings_fixed.finding: Nine legacy checkpoints and the frozen base dataset were not distributed with the clean-source audit; the dependency list omitted Torch.
findings_fixed.fix: Restored the nine checkpoints byte-exactly from development data, archived all 18 and the exact base input, added pinned direct dependencies, and reproduced complete historical records and sensitivity diagnostics. Failed restoration attempts are retained separately.

findings_fixed.finding: The paper verifier overwrote its freeze records by default, and legacy adapter hashing was checkout-dependent.
findings_fixed.fix: Made release checking read-only and fail-closed, restricted refresh to explicit prepublication use, and added a narrow newline-compatible adapter audit wrapper with tamper and restoration tests.

verification.clean_source_overlay: The final portable attribution wrapper, its tests, and refreshed verification/freeze records were copied into the source archive. The numerical wrapper hash is bound in cross_domain_archived_inference_verification_v1_2.json.
verification.initial_clean_source_failure: The historical attribution helper rejected an LF checkout of a registered JSON adapter. The wrapper now permits only newline-equivalent text; all numerical comparisons remain exact.
verification.note: Checks overlap and share producer routines; their count is not a count of independent replications. Clean-source audits used the installed Python 3.12 environment.

remaining_research_limits: No independent execution or externally controlled dynamics/labels for the new synthetic study.
No isolated causal attribution of gains to data, architecture, objective, ensembling, or calibration.
No demonstrated beneficial controller outcome or physical safety from the new warnings.
Older QEMU and external-simulator executions were not repeated; their audit prerequisites and evidence boundaries remain explicit.
